hero.subtitle: Breathe. Flow. Blossom. Join our community and discover the transformative power of yoga.

about.title: The Lotus Path
about.subtitle: About Yoga Hoa Sen
about.body: Like the lotus flower that rises from muddy waters to bloom in pristine beauty, our practice helps you find clarity, peace, and radiance from within. Yoga Hoa Sen is a sanctuary where tradition meets modern life — a place to root down and rise up.
about.body2: Founded in 2018, we bring together experienced teachers, an authentic Vietnamese spirit, and evidence-based wellness practices to nurture body, mind, and soul.

hatha.name: Hatha Yoga
hatha.desc: Classical postures and breath work to build strength, flexibility, and inner calm.

vinyasa.name: Vinyasa Flow
vinyasa.desc: Fluid sequences synchronised with breath — dynamic, energising, and meditative.

yin.name: Yin Yoga
yin.desc: Long-held postures targeting deep connective tissue. Stillness as medicine.

meditation.name: Meditation
meditation.desc: Guided mindfulness, breathwork, and mantra practices for lasting mental clarity.

prenatal.name: Prenatal Yoga
prenatal.desc: Gentle, safe practice supporting mothers-to-be through every trimester.

kids.name: Kids Yoga
kids.desc: Playful, imaginative sessions helping children build focus and body awareness.
